author: The Infographics Show
description:
Why do some people panic when a partner pulls away, while others shut down the moment things get too close?

Attachment theory describes four common relationship patterns. Secure, anxious-preoccupied, dismissive-avoidant, and fearful-avoidant. These patterns can influence how we handle intimacy, rejection, conflict, and emotional security. Some people constantly seek reassurance, but others value independence so strongly that closeness feels uncomfortable. And some crave love while also being afraid of it. But attachment styles aren’t permanent labels.
Our brains continue to change throughout life, and understanding these patterns can help us recognize why we react the way we do,and how to build healthier relationships.

Which attachment style sounds most like you?
